"""Real DDS grouped receipt/latched-QoS/graph-only rejection, no mission."""
import hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "scripts"))
from ros_smoke_test import require_messages

producer_source = '''import os, signal, rclpy
from rclpy.node import Node
from rclpy.qos import QoSProfile, ReliabilityPolicy, DurabilityPolicy
from sensor_msgs.msg import LaserScan
from nav_msgs.msg import OccupancyGrid
from std_msgs.msg import String
rclpy.init()
node=Node("p3b5_grouped_message_fixture")
volatile=QoSProfile(depth=1, reliability=ReliabilityPolicy.BEST_EFFORT)
latched=QoSProfile(depth=1, reliability=ReliabilityPolicy.RELIABLE, durability=DurabilityPolicy.TRANSIENT_LOCAL)
scan=node.create_publisher(LaserScan,"/p3b5/group/scan",volatile)
grid=node.create_publisher(OccupancyGrid,"/p3b5/group/map",latched)
battery=node.create_publisher(String,"/p3b5/group/battery",latched)
absent=node.create_publisher(String,"/p3b5/group/advertised_without_data",10)
grid.publish(OccupancyGrid())
battery.publish(String(data="latched before observer initialization"))
timer=node.create_timer(.1,lambda:scan.publish(LaserScan()))
signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM,lambda *args:os._exit(0))
rclpy.spin(node)
'''
requests = [dict(topic="/p3b5/group/scan", qos_arguments=("--qos-reliability", "best_effort")),
            *[dict(topic="/p3b5/group/"+name, qos_arguments=("--qos-reliability", "reliable", "--qos-durability", "transient_local")) for name in ("map", "battery")]]
result = {"scope": "Real DDS component only; three actual types, one-shot latched samples, no Gazebo/task",
          "parent_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip(),
          "ros_domain_id": os.environ["ROS_DOMAIN_ID"], "source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
          "probe_source_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path("scripts/ros_smoke_test.py").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          "producer_source": producer_source, "requests": requests}
producer = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", producer_source])
try:
    time.sleep(.5)
    started = time.monotonic()
    require_messages(requests, 15.)
    result["three_actual_receipts_wall_sec"] = time.monotonic() - started
    started = time.monotonic()
    try:
        require_messages([*requests, dict(topic="/p3b5/group/advertised_without_data")], 2.)
    except (TimeoutError, RuntimeError) as error:
        result["advertised_no_data_rejected"] = repr(error)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("An advertised topic without data was falsely accepted")
    result["missing_receipt_wall_sec"] = time.monotonic() - started
    assert result["missing_receipt_wall_sec"] < 3.5
    result["status"] = "PASS"
finally:
    producer.terminate()
    producer.wait(timeout=5.)
    Path("/tmp/p3b5_grouped_native_real_checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps({k: v for k,v in result.items() if "source" not in k}))
